log: HOW MANY OF THE 1,400 ARE RIGHT -- and can we say which
calibration: 333 held-out reactions, same single-answer protocol, truth known
target:      1400 filled orphan rows, no truth and no answer key
1. THE STRATIFIER. Obscurity is defined on the TRUE catalyst, which the fill lacks. The
PREDICTED gene's literature count exists on every row -- does it track the truth's?
model predicted                n  truth obscure
an obscure gene               51         100.0%
a famous gene                282          16.3%
held-out truth-obscure share 29.1% (stratified by design)
the fill predicts an obscure gene on 1.6% of rows, so its implied truth-obscure
share is 17.6% -- against 29.1% in the benchmark. The benchmark is
HARDER than the fill on this axis, which is the opposite of what was assumed when the
obscure figure was quoted as the governing number for the whole worklist.

4. CAN WE NAME WHICH ONES? The confidence signal that separates best (0.891 against 0.456)
WAS NEVER COLLECTED for the fill -- its answers carry gene and why, nothing else. So the
question is whether the flags that do exist can substitute.
observable on every fill row                 AUC
example count                              0.532
predicted-gene literature count            0.413
full retrieval (>=12 examples)             0.562
a coin is 0.500. These are what a curator would have to triage on today.
5. THE HAND CHECK, RE-READ AGAINST GROUND TRUTH. 30 rows were verified by hand early on --
10 full-retrieval, 10 partial, 10 zero-example, which is within 4 points of the fill's own
30/37/33 split -- and scored 26/30. It was flagged at the time as NOT independent, because
the reviewer was the model that made the predictions. Held-out gives the size of that.
tier         hand check   measured     n  inflation
Self-review inflates by +0.14 overall, and the inflation is ORDERED: largest where the
examples were in front of both the predictor and the reviewer (+0.21 at full retrieval),
almost nil where there was nothing to agree with (+0.04 at zero examples). A second look
at shared evidence mostly re-endorses the first look; a second look at bare chemistry does
not. That is the mechanism, and it is why the closed-book arm withholds the examples.
READING
Point estimate 0.695 on 1367 scorable rows = about 950 correct, interval
[875, 1022]. That is an AGGREGATE. Nothing above tells a curator WHICH
950, because the one signal that separates well was never asked for. Part 3 of this
module -- an independent closed-book second opinion, calibrated on the same held-out set --
is the route to a per-row label. Run prep, then the agents, then score.
